'''Ree-Yees's camera''' was a custom made three-eye [[Camera/Legends|camera]] used by the criminal [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]] to accommodate his [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] physiology. He enjoyed visiting other planets via [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]], and often brought his camera to take pictures, despite flash photography not being allowed.<ref name="Toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Boarding Party|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/StarToursBoardingParty.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ree-Yees's camera can be seen in the onboard safety video for [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref> In the video, Ree-Yees is breaking the rules by [[Smoking/Legends|smoking]] and using flash photography.<ref name="YouTube">{{YouTube|video=s9NP6iSAkVo|text=Star Tours (Original) - The Complete Experience|channel=channel/UC8fE3Sd7b9Gp5sTITX16uCg|name=Anthony's Channel}}</ref> Ree-Yees was also included in a [[2010]] ''Star Tours'' Boarding Party action figure set with the three-eyed camera seen in the video; the packaging confirms his identity.<ref name="DPB">{{DPB|url=2010/02/disney-cast-member-figure-part-of-new-'star-tours'-set|text=Disney Cast Member Figure Part of New 'Star Tours' Set}}</ref>
